responsibility: Expose the HTTP endpoint for searching stations by name or code.
Expose the HTTP endpoint for retrieving arrival boards for a station/line pair.
Fetch raw arrivals for a line and transform them into direction-grouped, merged arrival boards for a station.
Parse a raw TfL platform name string into a structured direction and platform number.
Define the Station and Line data shapes and derive a station's 3-letter code.
Define the ArrivalBoard/ArrivalBoardEntry data shapes and format arrival countdown text.
Assemble the FastAPI application and wire up all API routers and CORS middleware.
non_responsibilities: Does not implement any request handling logic itself.
Does not perform any TfL data fetching or transformation.

public_interface.name: create_app
public_interface.description: Builds and configures the FastAPI application, including CORS and all routers (stations, arrivals, line statuses, station disruptions).
postconditions: Returned app has stations, arrivals, line-statuses and station-disruptions routers mounted.

responsibility: Perform raw HTTP calls to the TfL Unified API and parse responses into typed raw data structures.
non_responsibilities: Does not decide which lines or stations are relevant to the application (that is provided by callers).
Does not merge, group, or otherwise reinterpret disruption data for display.
Does not perform station lookups or validation.

public_interface.name: get_arrivals
public_interface.description: Fetches raw arrival predictions for every train currently running on the given line.
postconditions: Raises TflClientError if the TfL API request fails.

public_interface.name: get_line_statuses
public_interface.description: Fetches the current-day status (including any disruptions and their affected route sections) for the given lines.
postconditions: One RawLineStatus is returned per (line, concurrent disruption) status entry reported by TfL.
Raises TflClientError if the TfL API request fails.

public_interface.name: get_stop_point_disruptions
public_interface.description: Fetches all current tube station-level disruptions.
postconditions: Raises TflClientError if the TfL API request fails.

responsibility: Load and provide read access to the static station/line reference data, including lookup and search by station.
non_responsibilities: Does not fetch any live/real-time data from TfL.
Does not know about arrivals, disruptions, or line statuses.

public_interface.name: search_stations
public_interface.description: Finds stations whose name contains the query or whose 3-letter code matches the query exactly.

public_interface.name: get_station
public_interface.description: Looks up a single station by its id.

public_interface.name: list_line_ids
public_interface.description: Returns the ids of every tube line known to the reference data, for use when querying line-wide status.

responsibility: Define the data shapes used to present a line's disruption statuses grouped by severity, with merged route sections.
non_responsibilities: Does not fetch or compute any data itself.
Does not decide how route sections are merged or which severities are filtered out.

responsibility: Define the data shape used to present a single station-level disruption.
non_responsibilities: Does not fetch or filter disruption data itself.

responsibility: Fetch line statuses for all known lines and transform them into severity-grouped summaries with deduplicated, merged route sections, excluding lines with only Good Service.
non_responsibilities: Does not fetch station-level disruptions.
Does not perform any HTTP calls itself (delegates to TflClient).
Does not know about arrivals or platform parsing.
Does not decide HTTP status codes or handle web-layer concerns.

public_interface.name: get_line_status_summaries
public_interface.description: Returns, for every tube line, its non-Good-Service statuses grouped by severity, with route sections merged into bidirectional pairs where both directions are disrupted.
postconditions: Lines whose only status is Good Service are omitted from the result.
Each route section's start/end station names have any 'Underground Station' suffix stripped.
A route section appears as bidirectional when both the (A, B) and (B, A) directions are reported as affected.

responsibility: Fetch all tube station disruptions and filter them down to the ones affecting a single requested station.
non_responsibilities: Does not fetch line-wide statuses.
Does not perform any HTTP calls itself (delegates to TflClient).
Does not decide HTTP status codes or handle web-layer concerns.

public_interface.name: get_station_disruptions
public_interface.description: Returns the disruptions currently affecting the given station.
postconditions: Raises StationNotFoundError if station_id is not a known station.

responsibility: Expose the HTTP endpoint for retrieving disruption status summaries for all tube lines.
non_responsibilities: Does not fetch or transform TfL data itself.
Does not implement any station-specific logic.

public_interface.name: get_line_statuses
public_interface.description: GET handler returning the current disruption status summary for every tube line.

responsibility: Expose the HTTP endpoint for retrieving the disruptions affecting a specific station.
non_responsibilities: Does not fetch or transform TfL data itself.
Does not implement any line-wide logic.

public_interface.name: get_station_disruptions
public_interface.description: GET handler returning the disruptions currently affecting the given station.
postconditions: Responds 404 when station_id is not a known station.

responsibility: Declare the client-side routes and mount the page for each route.
Bootstrap the React application into the DOM.
Provide global CSS (Tailwind entry point).
Provide Vite's ambient TypeScript type declarations.
Let the user pick which line to view when a searched station is served by more than one line.
Render a single direction's arrival board as a table of upcoming trains.
Define the TypeScript types shared between the API client and the pages/components.
non_responsibilities: Does not perform any data fetching or transformation.

responsibility: Provide typed functions for calling the backend HTTP API and translating error responses.
non_responsibilities: Does not render any UI.
Does not hold component state.

public_interface.name: getArrivalBoards
public_interface.description: Calls the arrivals endpoint for a station/line pair.

public_interface.name: getLineStatuses
public_interface.description: Calls the line statuses endpoint to retrieve disruption summaries for all lines.

public_interface.name: getStationDisruptions
public_interface.description: Calls the station disruptions endpoint for a given station.

responsibility: Let the user search for a station and view current line status disruptions.
non_responsibilities: Does not render an individual line status block's internals (delegates to LineStatusCard).
Does not compute route section merging (that is done by the backend).

public_interface.name: HomePage
public_interface.description: Page component rendering the station search box and results, plus a line status section listing disrupted lines.

responsibility: Show the live, auto-refreshing arrival boards and current disruptions for a chosen station/line.
non_responsibilities: Does not render an individual disruption's markup (delegates to StationDisruptionList).
Does not compute disruption filtering (that is done by the backend).

public_interface.name: BoardPage
public_interface.description: Page component rendering back navigation, station disruptions, and arrival board cards for the selected station/line.

responsibility: Render one line's disruption statuses grouped by severity with their route sections, and toggle all reason texts together on click.
non_responsibilities: Does not fetch data.
Does not decide which lines to display (parent page filters via the API response).

public_interface.name: LineStatusCard
public_interface.description: Component rendering a line's name (click target), followed by each severity's route sections, with reasons shown or hidden together based on click state.
postconditions: Reasons are hidden by default and all shown/hidden together when the line name is clicked.

responsibility: Render a list of station disruptions, colored red for type 'Closure' and blue otherwise.
non_responsibilities: Does not fetch data.
Does not filter which disruptions belong to the station (parent page passes the already-filtered list).

public_interface.name: StationDisruptionList
public_interface.description: Component rendering each disruption's description, colored according to its type.
